description: This file defines the Informix database driver class for the ADOdb PHP database abstraction layer, including connection handling, SQL generation, metadata retrieval, and recordset management specific to Informix 7.2.

classes.name: ADODB_informix72
classes.description: Driver class for connecting and executing queries on Informix 7.2 database.

classes.name: ADORecordset_informix72
classes.description: Recordset class for handling query results from Informix 7.2.

methods.name: _insertID
methods.description: Fetches the last insert ID from the SQLCA structure.

methods.name: _affectedrows
methods.description: Returns the number of affected rows from the last query.

methods.name: RowLock
methods.description: Locks a row for update based on a condition.

methods.name: ErrorMsg
methods.description: Returns the last database error message.

methods.name: MetaColumns
methods.description: Retrieves column metadata for a table.

methods.name: xMetaColumns
methods.description: Alias for MetaColumns with normalization disabled.

methods.name: metaForeignKeys
methods.description: Retrieves foreign key constraints for a table.

methods.name: UpdateBlob
methods.description: Updates a BLOB or TEXT column with new data.

methods.name: BlobDecode
methods.description: Decodes a BLOB to a usable form.

methods.name: _connect
methods.description: Establishes a connection to the database.

methods.name: _query
methods.description: Executes an SQL query, managing input parameters and cursor type.
